executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost per resident day ($5.13) was 42% of the Connecticut median ($12.32). Ask how housekeeping is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $143.89 per resident day (44.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $8,509,078 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 33,330 Medicaid days, $255.3 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $262.77 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $273.44 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 9.3% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $44,151, 0.7% of the $6,465,510 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $942,349, $20.97 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $459,768 (48.8%), allocated fringe $53,405 (5.7%), non-wage costs $429,176 (45.5%). Raw food was $319,326 ($7.11 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $77,793.
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2019, 2020, 2023 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
